description: This file implements the 'source' repository layer for managing URL and branch ID mappings using an SQL database with an LRU cache in a version control diff tool.

classes.name: source
classes.description: Struct representing the source repository, holding a database connection.

methods.name: getOrCreateURLBranchID
methods.description: Retrieves the ID for a given URL and branch, creating it if it doesn't exist, with caching.

methods.name: getOrCreateURLBranchIDPersistence
methods.description: Internal method to ensure an ID exists for a URL and branch, inserting if necessary.

methods.name: insertIgnoreError
methods.description: Inserts a new URL and branch record into the database, ignoring errors.

methods.name: getIDByURLBranch
methods.description: Fetches the ID for a given URL and branch from the database.

methods.name: GetURLBranchByID
methods.description: Retrieves the URL and branch for a given ID, using cache or database lookup.

methods.name: getURLBranchByIDPersistence
methods.description: Internal method to get URL and branch from the database for a given ID.

methods.name: DiffTargetToMapped
methods.description: Converts a DiffTarget with URL/branch into a MappedDiffTarget with IDs.

methods.name: NewSourceRepository
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the source repository, establishing a database connection.
